title: Deep Transfer Learning Based Classification Model for COVID-19 Disease

sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:
《Deep Transfer Learning Based Classification Model for COVID-19 Disease》：研究问题的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-1】The COVID-19 infection is increasing at a rapid rate, with the availability of limited number of testing kits.

evidence.text: The COVID-19 infection is increasing at a rapid rate, with the availability of limited number of testing kits.

sections.title: 研究方法
sections.text:
《Deep Transfer Learning Based Classification Model for COVID-19 Disease》：方法与研究设计的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-3】Recently, many studies have shown that chest Computed Tomography (CT) images can be used for COVID-19 testing, as chest CT images show a bilateral change in COVID-19 infected patients.

【Abstract · abstract-1-4】However, the classification of COVID-19 patients from chest CT images is not an easy task as predicting the bilateral change is defined as an ill-posed problem.

evidence.text: Recently, many studies have shown that chest Computed Tomography (CT) images can be used for COVID-19 testing, as chest CT images show a bilateral change in COVID-19 infected patients.
However, the classification of COVID-19 patients from chest CT images is not an easy task as predicting the bilateral change is defined as an ill-posed problem.
